page.loadFailed: The client list could not be loaded.

table.title: Merchant directory
table.description: Businesses that ship parcels with this company
table.search: Search name, code, contact or mobile

tip.title: Merchants pay, recipients receive.
tip.description: A client is the business shipping parcels. Its balance changes only through ledger entries in billing, never by editing the profile.

form.coordinatesNote: Optional. Give both, in decimal degrees, so drivers can find the pickup point.
form.tipDescription: The client code appears on waybills and invoices. A new account starts with a zero balance; billing posts every change after that.

details.payoutDue: Net positive: payout due to the merchant
details.merchantOwes: Net negative: the merchant owes this amount
details.archivedNote: Its history stays. New parcels can't be created for it until it is reactivated.
details.tipDescription: Archiving stops new parcels but keeps every parcel, ledger entry, and invoice linked to this client.

archive.confirmArchive: No new parcels can be created for this merchant. Its parcels, balance, and invoices stay as they are.
archive.confirmReactivate: The merchant can ship new parcels again, with the same code and terms.

errors.invalidCode: Use 2–32 letters, digits, or dashes, e.g. CL-0007.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address, e.g. billing@example.com.
errors.coordinatePair: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.
errors.codeTaken: This client code is already used by another client.
errors.notFound: This client doesn't exist in this company.
